trigger: DEV-CAL-2 V2 terminal AMORTISATION_DOMINATED (PR #345 merged 5d10d910): KO-2 carries the oracle transfer at 1.0000 [1.0,1.0] determinate 3/3 on compute-matched work, but NO tier recovers on total_burden_incl_acquisition (secondary shuffle-null alarm p=0.0); the DEV-CAL-2 freeze authorises work on the amortisation structure ONLY, carrier = charging model
central_question: which component of the current charging model makes acquisition costs non-amortising: failed-attempt charging, verification charging, development-stream (mining) charging, full-charge-per-use accounting, or absence of salvage/depreciation?

method.no_new_protected_run: no new worlds, seeds, arms-at-runtime, or scored execution; the sealed V2 event/cost ledgers are the sole input, bound by exact path: research/hsg-semantic-execution-v1/exact/results/DEV_CAL_2_SCORED_RESULTS_V1.json + _V2.json, research/hsg-semantic-execution-v1/exact/receipts/DEVCAL2_receipts_shard{1..4}_V2.jsonl (+ V1 shards byte-identical-preserved, DEVCAL2_HOST_RECEIPT_billy_V2.json); sha256 of every input recorded in the analysis receipt before recomputation
method.legitimacy: the DEV-CAL-2 freeze authorises amortisation-structure work; recomputing burden under alternative charge semantics on sealed ledgers is analysis of authorised structure, not a new assay; all recomputations must reproduce the AS_IS control numbers exactly before any alternative is reported
method.leakage_rule: alternative charge semantics are applied POST HOC to recorded events only; no event, order, or outcome may be re-simulated, re-ordered, or dropped

charge_semantics_arms.AS_IS: control: the V2 charging model exactly; must reproduce every V2 primary/secondary number within exact equality (any mismatch = ASSAY_DEFECT, the analysis halts)
charge_semantics_arms.NO_FAILURE_CHARGE: failed enumeration/verification attempts charged at zero (they still occur, still count for behaviour metrics, cost zero)
charge_semantics_arms.NO_VERIFICATION_CHARGE: external CHECKER_C calls charged at zero
charge_semantics_arms.NO_MINING_CHARGE: development-stream costs (fragment mining, dev-task solving) excluded from target burden
charge_semantics_arms.MARGINAL_COST_ONLY: each retrieval/use charges its marginal cost; acquisition cost retires at a registered amortisation threshold (frozen: first N=10 uses, sensitivity reported at N in {5,10,25})
charge_semantics_arms.SALVAGE_MODEL: failed traces credited their measured information value at the empirical reuse rate recorded in the ledgers

endpoint_and_stats.primary: under each charge semantics, the tier-recovery and total_burden_incl_acquisition readouts recomputed for every DEV-CAL-2 tier/LOO cell; attribution = which single component's reform flips the secondary readout to recovery while leaving the KO-2 primary transfer intact
endpoint_and_stats.stats: paired per-cell recomputation intervals, lineage/ecology clustering, Holm over the five alternative arms, 20% registered margin, NULL_BAND_GATED direction tests (AM-5 standing); the AS_IS control is exact-equality gated, not interval tested
endpoint_and_stats.claim_rule: attribution is per-component; a component whose reform does NOT flip the readout is EXONERATED and lands as a standing invariant

terminals.meaning: CHARGE_CARRIER_k names the ledger component that kills amortisation at this scope ONLY; NONE means the non-amortisation is structural in the acquisition pipeline rather than the ledger and routes the revival back to the M1B mechanism-attribution lane; every terminal authorises at most a PROSPECTIVE REGISTRATION for a redesigned charging model (economics = M3 territory, explicitly not claimable here)

forbidden: any new scored/protected run, world, seed, or runtime arm
editing sealed V1/V2 receipts or their bindings (analysis outputs land under new names, never overwrite)
designing or deploying a new charging model inside this lane (that is a separate prospective registration)
using an oracle-transplant number as a headline comparator
negatives_to_invariants: every exonerated component lands as a class-level invariant (e.g. VERIFICATION_NOT_CARRIER: verification share of total burden on this ecology recorded with its bound) in the same PR as the result
ASSAY_DEFECT and CANNOT_CHECK preserved honestly; never massaged
entry_gates: this freeze merged before any recomputation is reported
the recomputation script passes a hostile selftest including an AS_IS-mismatch hostile (planted drift must alarm) and a no-alarm control, on the run host

hosts.recompute_and_rollup: laptop billy (compute off-Mac rule; receipts fetched sha256-verified)

explicitly_not_authorized: reporting any alternative-semantics number before the AS_IS control reproduces V2 exactly
treating a recomputed number as a NEW terminal of DEV-CAL-2 (DEV-CAL-2's verdict stands; this lane attributes its carrier)
